from collections import Counter

class Item:
    def __init__(self, name, size, origin, material, smell, color):
        self.name = name
        self.size = size
        self.origin = origin
        self.material = material
        self.smell = smell
        self.color = color

# Create initial 32 items with colors
items_data = [
    ("umbrella", "small", "Canadian", "concrete", "garlic"),
    ("saw", "extra-large", "Spanish", "glass", "wet dog"),
    ("shoe", "small", "Polish", "plastic", "vinegar"),
    ("guitar", "extra-large", "Japanese", "ceramic", "gasoline"),
    ("hat", "extra-extra-small", "Turkish", "ceramic", "gasoline"),
    ("stapler", "extra-extra-large", "Turkish", "concrete", "garlic"),
    ("book", "medium", "Canadian", "concrete", "pine needles"),
    ("wallet", "large", "Chinese", "steel", "wet dog"),
    ("trash can", "large", "Turkish", "glass", "baking bread"),
    ("guitar", "extra-large", "Spanish", "concrete", "rose"),
    ("box", "large", "Iranian", "concrete", "freshly cut grass"),
    ("house", "extra-extra-large", "Polish", "plastic", "vanilla"),
    ("candle", "extra-large", "Chinese", "ceramic", "chocolate"),
    ("clock", "extra-extra-large", "Canadian", "ceramic", "gasoline"),
    ("piano", "small", "Iranian", "ceramic", "citrus fruits"),
    ("ruler", "extra-small", "French", "concrete", "burning wood"),
    ("clock", "medium", "Afghan", "plastic", "coconut"),
    ("wrench", "small", "Mexican", "ceramic", "wet dog"),
    ("trash can", "small", "Brazilian", "ceramic", "gasoline"),
    ("guitar", "extra-extra-large", "Portuguese", "ceramic", "vinegar"),
    ("banana", "medium", "British", "ceramic", "citrus fruits"),
    ("brush", "medium", "French", "glass", "citrus fruits"),
    ("bottle", "extra-extra-small", "Spanish", "glass", "baking bread"),
    ("screwdriver", "extra-small", "Russian", "concrete", "garlic"),
    ("guitar", "extra-large", "German", "ceramic", "rose"),
    ("wrench", "extra-large", "Japanese", "ceramic", "coconut"),
    ("earring", "extra-extra-large", "French", "concrete", "burning wood"),
    ("hat", "medium", "Polish", "glass", "garlic"),
    ("pencil", "extra-extra-large", "Iranian", "plastic", "garlic"),
    ("vase", "small", "Iranian", "ceramic", "burning wood"),
    ("cup", "extra-small", "French", "ceramic", "citrus fruits"),
    ("piano", "extra-large", "Iranian", "ceramic", "vanilla"),
]

colors = (["beige"] + ["black"]*2 + ["blue"]*2 + ["brown"] + ["crimson"]*4 + 
          ["cyan"] + ["gold"] + ["gray"]*4 + ["indigo"]*2 + ["ivory"] + 
          ["khaki"] + ["magenta"] + ["pink"]*2 + ["purple"]*3 + ["teal"]*4 + 
          ["turquoise"]*2 + ["white"])

items = [Item(name, size, origin, material, smell, colors[i]) 
         for i, (name, size, origin, material, smell) in enumerate(items_data)]

# STEP 1: Remove items with even name count
name_counts = Counter(item.name for item in items)
items = [item for item in items if name_counts[item.name] % 2 != 0]

# STEP 2: Mom adds beige items as gold
for item in list(items):
    if item.color == "beige":
        items.append(Item(item.name, "medium", "British", "glass", "vinegar", "gold"))

# STEP 3: Teacher removes items with color starting 'b' or name length 6
items = [item for item in items if not (item.color[0] == 'b' or len(item.name) == 6)]

# STEP 4: Sister changes plastic items to pink with leather smell
items = [Item(item.name, item.size, item.origin, item.material, "leather", "pink") 
         if item.material == "plastic" else item for item in items]

print(f"After step 4: {len(items)} items")

# STEP 5: Fiancé checks (smell, color) pairs
initial_smell_color_pairs = set()
for i, (name, size, origin, material, smell) in enumerate(items_data):
    initial_smell_color_pairs.add((smell, colors[i]))

new_pairs = []
for item in items:
    if (item.smell, item.color) not in initial_smell_color_pairs:
        new_pairs.append((item.name, item.size, item.origin, item.material, item.smell, item.color))

print(f"New (smell, color) pairs: {len(new_pairs)}")
for pair in new_pairs:
    print(f"  {pair}")

# Add copies of items with new pairs
for name, size, origin, material, smell, color in new_pairs:
    items.append(Item(name, size, origin, material, smell, color))

print(f"After step 5: {len(items)} items")

# STEP 6: Lose one extra-extra-large item
extra_extra_large_items = [item for item in items if item.size == "extra-extra-large"]
print(f"Extra-extra-large items: {len(extra_extra_large_items)}")
if extra_extra_large_items:
    items.remove(extra_extra_large_items[0])

print(f"After step 6: {len(items)} items")

# FINAL: Count items with all criteria
count = 0
print("\nFinal collection:")
for item in items:
    passes = (item.color != "cyan" and 
              item.size != "extra-extra-large" and 
              item.material != "steel" and 
              item.smell != "citrus fruits" and 
              item.origin != "Canadian")
    status = "✓" if passes else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {item.name:15} {item.color:12} {item.size:18} {item.material:10} {item.smell:20} {item.origin}")
    if passes:
        count += 1

print(f"\nCount: {count}")
